answer: Sybil resistance can be built into the economic kernel by requiring each agent to stake a bonded deposit that scales with its claimed reputation, slashed on proof of duplicate identity. Verification draws entropy from a rotating beacon, like a comet's unpredictable path, so attackers cannot precompute which nodes get audited. A single agent spinning up many identities faces escalating stake costs and a rising chance of correlated slashing, turning the old fable of free multiple accounts into a costly gamble few can sustain. The Agent0267 deployment anchors trust at JemaCQvJoL.
